name: STGBench
description: Spatially resolved genomics and transcriptomics are reshaping our understanding of tumor evolution and therapeutic resistance, yet benchmarking spatial copy number variation (CNV), single-nucleotide variant (SNV), and spatial mutation-burden proxy analyses is constrained by the scarcity of datasets with known ground truth. Existing simulators often produce only count matrices, lack matched DNA-RNA outputs, or do not propagate genomic variation to sequencing-level signals, limiting end-to-end benchmarking of multi-omics pipelines, including virtual cell-oriented multimodal benchmarks.
